name: Pink Coquette Bow Stethoscope Badge Reel
seoTitle: Pink Bow Nurse Badge Reel, Cute Coquette Gift
metaDescription: A cute pink bow badge reel for nurses, CNAs, and medical assistants who like a soft, girly touch on their ID. A sweet small gift for coworkers.
summary: A pink coquette bow badge reel that adds a little sweetness to a hospital ID. An easy, budget friendly gift for the nurse who loves pink.
whyItWorks: Badges get flashed dozens of times a shift: at the med room, the supply closet, the elevator, the time clock. A retractable reel means the ID snaps back instead of dangling into a patient's lap or tangling with a stethoscope. The pink bow design leans into the coquette trend, so it reads as playful without looking childish, and it gives a nurse something cheerful to glance down at on a long day.

Small gifts like this travel well through a unit. They work for a new hire welcome, a preceptor thank you, or a little something tucked into a Nurses Week goodie bag. The title lists a 24 inch nylon cord and an alligator clip, which covers how most people wear a badge on scrubs, a lanyard, or a pocket. Pair it with a favorite snack or a pen and you have a thoughtful desk drop for the nurses station.
goodToKnow: The alligator clip attaches to a collar, pocket, or waistband, so think about where she usually wears her badge.
Some hospitals have badge rules, so a new hire may want to confirm decorative reels are allowed.
Check the listing photos for the exact shade of pink and the bow size.

faq.q: Is this badge reel sturdy enough for daily hospital use?
faq.a: The title lists a durable nylon cord and an acrylic front, which is typical for everyday reels. Like any badge reel it will see a lot of pulls, so it makes a nice gift that is easy to rotate or replace.

faq.q: Who is it a good fit for?
faq.a: Anyone who wears an ID at work and likes a feminine, pink style, including RNs, LPNs, CNAs, and medical assistants. It also works for nursing students who wear clinical badges.
